DJ HYPERGIANT is back at it again? You bet! This new series is actually kinda wacky and has been a lot of work to put together but I found some old tapes from around the first run of the full moon mixtapes in 2017 where I had made a ton of crazy beats all shoved into these really blown out bass boosted cassettes. I ran those into some old samplers and used them to make a kind collage of noisy ambient beats. There's limitations to how much I could record until time ran out. Anyway this is an homage to that and made entirely with my sp404a & sp404mk2.
Anyway, please enjoy.
